new_checks: Remote point and DEM URLs rejected before native remote open
Offline verification script drives real GUI and validates independent Shapefile outputs
Real per-feature text and numeric heights change computed visibility
Both observer and receiver attribute heights
Ten selected points produce exactly ten primary Shapefiles
Selected source names retained in name column
Persian names and UTF-8 DBF round trip
Invalid heights report FID and field before creating outputs
Height unit conversion and metre-based filenames
GUI checkbox, field selectors, actual worker and split files
Standalone bundle performs named independent exports
algorithm: Accepted 3.0 transmitter-at-point / receiver-on-cells mapping is retained; underlying GDAL viewshed algorithm is unchanged.
limitations: Windows runtime packaging and firewall verification are recorded separately by the release workflow in WINDOWS_OFFLINE_VALIDATION.json.
Split files are generated for selected FIDs; FID=-1 processes all valid input points.
The selected name must fit the Shapefile 254-byte UTF-8 field limit; long filenames are shortened without truncating valid attribute names.
No uploaded user geometry is included in this source package.
